statement: If uniform score error Assumption 2 and the occupancy small-margin Assumption 3 hold, then a top-k policy has expected finite-horizon reachability regret bounded by C times the sum of epsilon_b^(beta+1), for a finite constant C depending only on the margin parameters.

quantifiers.initial_distribution: the theorem displays expectation for x0 distributed as Q
quantifiers.policy: a top-k policy pi_{h,k}; the paper defines only its candidate set and does not impose a within-set selection rule
quantifiers.constant: some finite C depending on C_delta and beta

assumptions: The relevant state-action domain is compact.
The score error is uniformly at most epsilon_b on that domain.
The occupancy distribution obeys nu_b(Delta_b^(k) <= t) <= C_delta t^beta for all sufficiently small positive t.
The deployed action remains in the score-defined top-k candidate set.
falsification_condition: All assumptions hold, epsilon_1 is zero, and a permitted top-2 policy has positive regret, while the claimed right-hand side is zero for every finite C.
